hypothese.summary: A bet on the continuation of the AI accelerated-computing supercycle (revenue x8 in 4 fiscal years). China is still treated as a pure option (rumoured Beijing approval for <200k H200, unconfirmed as of 09/07/2026) and not as a figure taken for granted, in line with management's own guidance, which explicitly excludes it.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
Nvidia is the central bet on generative-AI compute infrastructure - not 'selling GPUs' but being the STRUCTURAL BOTTLENECK of the largest capital-investment cycle in recent history (Data Center 75.2bn of 81.6bn Q1 FY27 revenue, +92% YoY; revenue 8x in four fiscal years). Q2 FY27 guided ~91bn EXCLUDING China - any H200 unblocking is free optionality, integrated only on OFFICIAL confirmation. The report lands 26/08/2026.

== THESIS READ ==
- The 91bn Q2 bar (ex-China) is the imminent test; the model's FY27 (+81% revenue) leans on the guided ramp plus Rubin cycle. Watch: 26/08 print and whether China stays excluded from the next guide.
- Deceleration is MODELED, not feared: FY29-31 growth fades from +36% to +14% with margin easing - the thesis survives normalization. Watch: hyperscaler capex plans as the leading indicator.
- GAAP/non-GAAP convergence (SBC no longer excluded from Q1 FY27) can blur consensus comparisons still in the old format. Watch: basis labels on every consensus snapshot.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Fiscal year ends late January: 'data' FY26 = year ended Jan 2026; horizon FY27-FY31. Published FY26 ETR ~9.7% (FDII/R&D credits) vs 17% normative - +5.1bn residual documented, not reconducted. Bridge finNet flat +2.5bn (embedded in the fiche's conversion) - conservative vs the 90-to-320bn cash build, flagged to steepen. dernierCall absent (to initialize at the 26/08 report). priorEPS null (young fiche).

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
FY27: revenue 391bn, EBIT 262.8bn (67.2%), EPS 9.10 (consensus-aligned); FY28-FY31: growth +41/+36/+24/+14%, EBIT margin easing 68 -> 70 -> ~70%, ETR 17%, shares -1.6%/yr. Watch: 26/08 report (dernierCall init + first gH archive); China policy; networking attach rates; custom-ASIC competitive encroachment (AVGO).

== CATALYSTS ==
Q2 FY27 report (26/08/2026 - next week); Rubin launch cadence; China H200 official decision; hyperscaler 2027 capex frames.

ancrages.moteur: Official Q2 FY27 guidance (91 Md$ of revenue +/-2%, gross margin ~75%, opex ~8.3-8.5 Md$), which anchors the starting point of the FY27 consensus and explicitly excludes any China Data Center revenue.

Cross-checked sell-side consensus (Seeking Alpha, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, BofA) for FY27 EPS (~9.10$) and FY28 (~13.20$), used as a direct anchor rather than a bottom-up revenue->EBIT->Net retrofit, given the scale of the uncertainties on the Data Center/Networking mix at that horizon.

Extrapolation of a gradual slowdown in the EPS growth rate (from +45% in FY28 towards +17% in FY31) beyond the reliable consensus horizon (FY27-28), by the simple law of large numbers - no specific source beyond FY28/29, markedly lower confidence.
EBIT margin expansion towards 67-70% by FY27-31, driven by opex growing markedly more slowly than revenue (as observed FY25->FY26: opex +40% vs revenue +65%), capped at 70% for prudence.
Normative tax rate of 17%, in the middle of the official FY27 guidance range (16-18%), rolled forward for simplicity across the whole projection horizon.

Buyback authorisation of 80 Md$ approved on 18/05/2026 (on top of the 38.5 Md$ still outstanding) and a policy of returning about 50% of free cash flow, translated into a moderate decline in the diluted share count (~-1.7%/yr on average) over the projection horizon.
The free cash flow generated far exceeds the 50% paid out to shareholders and the capex, which keeps net cash (cash + investments less debt) growing even after buybacks/dividends.

2026.residualNote: Published FY26 (ended Jan 2026) effective tax ~9.7% (FDII/R&D credits at scale) vs the 13.5% used here and 17% normative in projections - the +5.1bn residual is a documented tax-efficiency block, deliberately not reconducted at full strength. Projected finNet is a FLAT +2.5bn embedded in the fiche's conversion - conservative vs the growing cash pile (90 -> 320bn), to steepen at a future refresh.

guidanceScorecard.paceCheckpoint: Q1 FY27 real: Data Center 75.2bn (+92%); the 91bn Q2 guide excludes any China H200 resumption - upside optionality, not in the model.

dernierCall.source: Seeking Alpha full transcript (article 4907259), read 2026-08-20; GAAP figures cross-checked stockanalysis.com

epsAdj.basisNote: Headline beat basis (Seeking Alpha: EPS $1.87 vs $1.77, +$0.10; revenue beat +$2.5B). GAAP diluted EPS printed far higher at $2.39, lifted by non-operating items (mark-to-market gains on the equity-investment portfolio); recurring comparison stays on the $1.87 basis.

epsReported.note: GAAP diluted EPS $2.39 on GAAP net income of $58.3B for the February-April 2026 quarter (ended April 26, 2026), per stockanalysis.com quarterly financials; revenue $81.6B.

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Q2 FY27: revenue $91B +/-2% (growth driven primarily by Data Center), GAAP gross margin 74.9% / non-GAAP 75.0% +/-50bp, OpEx ~$8.5B GAAP / ~$8.3B non-GAAP. Outlook again EXCLUDES any China data center compute revenue: H200 licenses approved by Washington but zero revenue booked and imports into China still uncertain.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY27: gross margins to stay mid-70s; OpEx growth now seen in the upper-40s % YoY (R&D plus AI-tools usage); GAAP/non-GAAP tax rate lowered to 16-18% (from 17-19%, geographic mix). Multi-year: $1 TRILLION cumulative Blackwell+Rubin revenue seen 2025 through calendar 2027 (doubled vs the $0.5T frame of Nov 2025); Vera Rubin production shipments start Q3 FY27 (up to 35x inference throughput vs Blackwell); ~$20B standalone Vera CPU revenue visibility this year on a new $200B TAM. Capital return: quarterly dividend raised $0.01 -> $0.25, new $80B buyback on top of $39B remaining, ~50% of FCF returned this year.
pointsCles: Record quarter, third straight YoY acceleration: revenue $81.6B (+85% YoY, +20% QoQ, record +$13.5B sequential step), Data Center $75B (+92% YoY; ~120% YoY ex-China) with compute $60B and networking $15B (near-tripled YoY; Spectrum-X now bigger than all Ethernet peers combined, InfiniBand x4 on XDR); record FCF $49B and record $20B returned to shareholders.

New reporting framework: two platforms, Data Center (Hyperscale $38B, +12% QoQ; ACIE $37B, +31% QoQ with AI-cloud revenue >3x YoY) and Edge Computing $6.4B (+29% YoY) absorbing former Gaming/ProViz/Auto; sovereign AI revenue +80% YoY across ~40 countries, >80 partner datacenters above 10MW; physical AI >$9B trailing-12-month revenue.

Product cycle de-risked: GB300 NVL72 fastest ramp in company history, MLPerf inference sweep (+2.7x throughput, -60% cost/token in 6 months); Vera Rubin on track for Q3 FY27 with POs already in hand from nearly all major customers and every frontier lab expected on it at launch; Anthropic added as strategic partner (capacity via AWS, Azure, CoreWeave), lifting NVIDIA's share of frontier compute; AWS to add >1M Blackwell/Rubin GPUs starting this year.

Capital-return pivot plus visibility: dividend x25 to $0.25/quarter, +$80B buyback, ~50% of FCF to shareholders; $1T Blackwell+Rubin revenue visibility through CY2027 backed by $145B total supply commitments; China stays a free option (H200 licenses granted, zero revenue assumed); hyperscale capex seen >$1T in 2027 and AI infrastructure spend $3-4T/year by end of decade. Next call: Q2 FY27 on August 26, 2026.

historique.message: The bottleneck thesis holds: Data Center 75.2bn of 81.6bn Q1 revenue (+92% YoY); Q2 FY27 guided ~91bn EXCLUDING China (H200 unblocking = pure optionality pending OFFICIAL confirmation, press reports insufficient per fiche rule); GAAP/non-GAAP convergence acted from Q1 FY27 (SBC no longer excluded) - consensus comparisons may still be labeled in the old format, flagged; Q2 FY27 report 26/08/2026 is the imminent verdict on the 91bn bar.
